messages:
Maya K: Heads-up — I just uploaded a ~10k vector batch to the preview and the modal basically froze for a few seconds. Also noticed keyboard navigation gets stuck on the per-row actions column when you try to tab across.

Ollie P: Hmm. Is that with `Show vectors` expanded or the compact list?

Maya K: Expanded. Compact is slightly better but still jumps focus back unexpectedly when the row actions menu renders.

Sofia R: Re: export copy — current CTA says "Export selection" which is vague. Suggest changing to "Download vectors (CSV)" and add an aria-label that mentions number of rows.

Juniper (a11y): +1 on clearer CTA. Also the export confirmation modal doesn't announce to screen readers when the file is ready. Need an aria-live region or toast with role=alert that reads e.g. "Vectors export ready: 3 files".

Sam - Eng: The freeze sounds like synchronous rendering when rows toggle the large SVG for similarity bars. We can defer rendering those until visible (virtualize) and add requestIdleCallback for non-critical icons.

Maya K: Another nit: when switching rerank mode on, the relevance scores column header doesn't have a sort button affordance — keyboard users can't toggle sort there.

Ollie P: Could we move the sort button into the header and expose it as a visible focus target? Also increase contrast of the sort icon (current 2.8:1).

Juniper (a11y): Contrast and keyboard targets both important. The header should have tabindex=0 and aria-sort updated on toggle. If we add a tooltip, ensure it's accessible (aria-describedby) rather than only hover.

Sofia R: Copy tweak: in the vectors preview row we show "0.83 similarity" — prefer "83% similarity" for readability. Also truncate long IDs but show full id on focus/hover with an accessible tooltip.

DesignBot: reminder: design token update rolling at 2026-03-01 16:00 UTC will change primary button padding.

Sam - Eng: For large batches, we'll lazy-load preview thumbnails and add an explicit "Render full preview" toggle to avoid auto heavy work. That should fix lag + remove keyboard trap.

Maya K: Ok, plan: (1) change export CTA to "Download vectors (CSV)", add aria-live on completion; (2) make header sort keyboard-focusable + aria-sort; (3) defer non-essential rendering + add "Render full preview" toggle; (4) change similarity formatting to percent; (5) increase sort icon contrast. Anyone object?

Ollie P: No objections. Can we also add a small performance hint under the batch upload modal: "For >5k vectors use background export to avoid UI lag"?

Juniper (a11y): And include a link to the accessibility docs for keyboard shortcuts in the modal footer.

Sofia R: I'll update the mock and prepare copy. Maya — want to pair on the tooltip wording?

Maya K: Yes, ping me when ready. Thanks all :raised_hands:

Sam - Eng: I'll put a branch up with the lazy-loading + aria-live toast PR today.

DesignBot: Reaction summary: :thumbsup: 3 — moving to design follow-up board.
